test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Walking at three-fifth of her usual speed, a girl reaches her workplace 1 hour 30 minutes late. What is her usual time of travel?
solution:
**Given:**

A girl walks = 3/5 of the usual speed

The girl reaches her workplace late by 1 hour 30 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

When distance is constant:

Time ∝ 1/Efficiency

**Calculation:**

As we know, time is inversely proportional to speed.

Let the usual speed of the girl be 5x

Speed of the girl after decreasing = 3x

Ratio of the usual speed to after decreasing = 5x : 3x

Ratio of usual time to after decreasing = 3x : 5x

Now,

5x – 3x = 1 hour 30 minutes or 90 minutes

⇒ 2x = 90

⇒ x = 45

⇒ 3x = 45 × 3 = 135 minutes or 2 hour 15 minutes

**∴ Her usual time of travel is 2 hour 15 minutes.**
